text:
Your AI keeps forgetting who you are. That is not the model's fault.

Gabe Coleman does mortgages. He is not a developer. On Tech Thursday he walked through the part of his setup nobody posts about -- not the prompts, the filing.

One brand voice file, written in markdown. Not a paragraph pasted into a chat window, an actual document: tone, rules, the words you never use. His line was blunt -- the best format is the .md file.

One folder per client. Separate projects so one brand's context cannot bleed into another's. The mortgage voice and the client voice never share a room.

Screenshots turned back into text. He runs images through a snippet tool so a flyer he liked becomes reusable language instead of a picture he squints at.

Work in batches. Not one post at a time. A whole set, one sitting, against one loaded context.

None of that is clever. All of it is why his output stays consistent while everyone else's drifts. Context is not what you say in the prompt. It is what was already in the room when you asked.
